name: Weapon Fumble Table

ranges.bows: Lose your grip. You elect not to attack. Good choice.
ranges.hand1: Lose your grip and the opportunity to get in an open blow. Maybe you will improve.
ranges.hand2: Lose your grip. You lose the opportunity to take an open swing.
ranges.mounted: Lose your grip. You lose the opportunity to take an open strike.
ranges.spearPole: Lose your grip. You lose the opportunity to take an open swing.
ranges.thrown: Lose your grip. You elect not to attack because of lost control.

ranges.bows: One's ten thumbs just cannot handle loading. You lose the rounds.
flags: spearPole: print reads 'youcan' (missing space); transcribed verbatim.
ranges.hand1: Drop your weapon. It will take 1 round to draw a new one, or 2 rounds to recover old one.
ranges.hand2: Drop your weapon. It will take 2 rounds to draw new one or 4 rounds to recover old one.
ranges.mounted: Fumble your delivery. You lose 2 rounds but can still parry.
ranges.spearPole: Fumble your delivery. You lose the option to attack but youcan still parry.
ranges.thrown: You fumble your delivery and hang onto your weapon. Subtract 10 from your next attack.

ranges.bows: You fumble your ammunition. You lose 2 rnds trying to recover. Real weak, kid.
ranges.hand1: You slip with grace and lose the opportunity to get in the vital blow.
ranges.hand2: You slip into fog of mind. You lose 1 round in order to collect your thoughts.
ranges.mounted: You slip and lose your saddle position. You lose 2 rounds but can still parry.
ranges.spearPole: You slip and are stunned for 1 round. All right, you just look clumsy. Try again.
ranges.thrown: You slip and lose 2 rounds to fully recover. You hold onto weapon and still parry.

ranges.bows: Break arrow and lose your cool. You find yourself out of 2 rounds of action.
ranges.hand1: Bad follow through. You lose your opportunity and give yourself 1 hit. Real weak.
ranges.hand2: Stumble over an unseen imaginary deceased turtle. You lose 2 rnds of offensive action but can parry.
ranges.mounted: Your mount rears and you are quite stunned for 2 rounds during the recovery.
ranges.spearPole: Lose your grip and juggle weapon for 2 rounds. You can still parry. Your next swing is at -10.
ranges.thrown: You fumble your weapon after losing your grip. You are stunned for 3 rounds.

ranges.bows: Drop your arrow. You lose 2 rounds reloading. Try hand arms next time.
ranges.hand1: You slip without grace and lose 2 rounds worth of opportunities. Good luck Pal.
ranges.hand2: Bad move. You lose 2 rounds of open swings. Fortunately, you can still parry.
ranges.mounted: You lose your grip and fumble your weapon. You are stunned for 3 rounds.
ranges.spearPole: You slip and almost fall. You are stunned and unable to parry for 2 rounds.
ranges.thrown: Poor release. Weapon lands harmlessly 20 feet to the left of target.

ranges.bows: Drop your bow. You lose 2 rounds while retrieving and reloading it.
flags: hand2: print reads 'Lose you grip' (missing 'r'); transcribed verbatim.
ranges.hand1: Lose your grip and juggle your weapon for 2 rounds. You can still parry.
ranges.hand2: Lose you grip and juggle your weapon for 2 rounds. You can still parry.
ranges.mounted: Your poor mount stumbles and you are stunned and unable to parry for 2 rounds.
ranges.spearPole: Lose your grip and juggle weapon for 3 rounds. Your next swing is at -10.
ranges.thrown: Very poor release sends weapon off directly to the right. Reroll if someone lies in the new path.

ranges.bows: Bowstring breaks. You lose 6 rnds while restringing bow or 2 rnds while drawing a new weapon.
ranges.hand1: Lose your grip and juggle your weapon for 2 rounds. Unfortunately, you cannot parry.
ranges.hand2: Very bad move. You are stunned and unable to parry for 2 rounds. Not good.
ranges.mounted: You break your weapon and lose 2 rounds while drawing a new one.
ranges.spearPole: Fumble your follow-through. You lose 3 rnds. You are stunned for 2 rounds.
ranges.thrown: You slip and lose 3 rounds to fully recover. You hold onto weapon, but cannot parry.

ranges.bows: You fumble your weapon. You are stunned and quite unable to parry for the next 3 rounds.
flags: mounted: print reads 'one of you lighter moments' (you for your); transcribed verbatim.
ranges.hand1: You lose your "wind" and realise that you should relax and not swing for 2 rounds.
ranges.hand2: Lose your grip and juggle your weapon for 3 rounds. You can still parry.
ranges.mounted: You drop your weapon in one of you lighter moments. Lose 2 rounds drawing a new one.
ranges.spearPole: Clumsy move. You are stunned and unable to parry for 3 rounds.
ranges.thrown: You drop your weapon. It will take 2 rounds to draw new one or 4 rounds to recover old one.

ranges.bows: You let your arrow fly much too soon. You strike 20 feet short of target. You are out 2 rounds.
ranges.hand1: Foe's smooth moves leave you stunned for 2 rounds. Hopefully, you will learn.
ranges.hand2: Incredibly bad move. You are stunned and unable to parry for 3 rounds.
ranges.mounted: You break your weapon and lose 2 rnds drawing a new one. You take 10 hits.
ranges.spearPole: Drop your weapon. It will take 2 rounds to draw new one or 6 rounds to recover old one.
ranges.thrown: You fumble your weapon badly but hang onto it. You are stunned and unable to parry for 6 rounds.

ranges.bows: Slip and fall down. You are stunned for 6 rounds, and unable to parry 2 rounds. Your shot goes astray.
ranges.hand1: You stumble. The classless display leaves you stunned for 3 rounds. You might still survive.
ranges.hand2: You stumble and nearly fall down in an apparent attempt to commit suicide. You are stunned 4 rounds.
ranges.mounted: Your seating is improper and you find yourself stunned and unable to parry for 3 rounds.
ranges.spearPole: You trip and fall. It will take 4 rounds to recover. You are unable to parry for 3 rounds.
ranges.thrown: You let go of weapon too early and send it off 30 feet behind you.

ranges.bows: Break your bow. You are stunned and unable to parry for 4 rnds of action. Good luck, pal.
ranges.hand1: Swallow tongue in the excitement. You are stunned and unable to parry for 3 rounds.
ranges.hand2: You trip and fall. It will take 4 rnds to recover. You are unable to parry for 3 rounds.
ranges.mounted: Your body takes the impact. You take 20 hits. Stunned and unable to parry/6 rnds.
ranges.spearPole: You injure your shoulder. You are stunned and unable to parry for 3 rnds and fight at -25.
ranges.thrown: You fall down. Your shot goes astray. You are stunned for 12 rounds.

ranges.bows: Poor judgement. You let arrow fly and lose an ear. +5 hits. You take 2 hits per round.
flags: mounted: print reads 'Role on the' (Role for Roll); transcribed verbatim.
thrown: print reads '"D\' critical' (D with apostrophe); transcribed verbatim.
ranges.hand1: Bad taste and poor execution. You attempt to maim yourself. Roll on the "D" critical table (slashes).
ranges.hand2: Worst move seen in ages. 50% chance you are out 2 days with a pulled groin. 50% chance opponent out 3 rnds laughing.
ranges.mounted: You fall off of your mount. Role on the "D" crush critical strike table.
ranges.spearPole: You break your weapon and are stunned and unable to parry for 6 rounds.
ranges.thrown: You hit yourself during delivery. Roll on the "D' critical strike table (crushes).

source: Arms Law & Claw Law, Weapon Fumble Table (printed p.90)
